rules.description: Students are prohibited from changing the Scheme and Institute fields.
rules.condition: When preparing or before submitting a renewal application.
rules.outcome: No changes can be made to the Scheme and Institute information.
rules.evidence_quote: The student will not be able to make changes in the Scheme and Institute.

rules.description: Students may submit a renewal application after updating their information successfully.
rules.condition: After the student has successfully updated the information.
rules.outcome: The student can submit the renewal application on the portal.
rules.evidence_quote: Upon successfully updating the information, the student can submit renewal application on the portal.

rules.description: Students cannot modify their application after it has been submitted.
rules.condition: After the student submits the renewal application.
rules.outcome: The student will not be allowed to make any changes in his/her application.
rules.evidence_quote: After submission, the student will not be allowed to make any change(s) in his/her application.
